第十三章 盖伦的猜测（二更求票）
秦家北府，一列列身穿银色厚重铠甲的家族卫队正在巡逻着，行走间，铠甲之间不断碰撞出刺耳的金属声，犀利的眸子四处扫荡，戒备极其森严。
北府东院。
一声炸响，眼前的木桌顿时爆裂，木屑飞扬，洒落一地，浑厚的一击直接令石质地板上印上一个深深的掌印。
“你们说的可是真的？”在那掌印后方，一名身穿华服的青年矗立着，脸上带着一抹淡淡的笑容，眼睛微眯，一副老好人的模样。
可若是仔细观察，不然发现其淡蓝色的眼眸中寒光连连，“老祖真的将那重宝交给了秦轩？”
在这名青年的前方，左右各站着一名年龄相仿的男子，当见到华服青年一击之威后，面露惊色，特别是感受来自青年身上那股毫不掩饰的冷意，心中暗自畏惧。
华服青年名叫秦易，年仅二十四岁，在秦家四府中排行老大，北府府主之子，不仅如此，他的实力，也是秦家四府年轻一辈中明面上的第一人！
然而，这并不是他令人畏惧的原因，虽然这人总是一副人畜无害的样子，但是心思却极其狡诈，就如一条躲在暗处的毒蛇，只要找到机会，便会择人而噬，一击必杀！
“大哥，这消息早已经在秦家四府中传开了，我们兄弟二人怎会骗你？”左边那名年龄稍大一点的男子说道，此人名为秦开，而另外一人则是秦和。
两人均已达到炼体九重的境界！
点了点头，秦和也是在一旁附和道，“没错大哥，那秦轩何德何能拥有重宝啊？论实力，他不过是炼体六重，连我兄弟二人都不及，更别提跟大哥您比了。”
“论天赋，更是不及您的十分之一，老祖宗竟将重宝交予他，也不知道老祖宗是不是被那小子蛊惑了！”
说罢，秦和一脸忿恨不平的模样，似乎为秦易而感到不值。
“呵呵……”
轻声一笑，秦易并没有立即说话，让人不知其心中到底在想些什么，心中的妒火悄然燃起。
在当初的族府大会时，他也曾因为一句‘重宝’而激动，热血，在他看来，以他的实力，这件‘重宝’根本就是属于他的！
所以在族府大会时，他只是冷眼旁观，不急于出手，不论是在族府大会嚣张跋扈的秦江伟，还是突然一鸣惊人的秦轩，不过都是一群跳梁小丑罢了。
可是，就是这样一个在他眼中如蝼蚁般存在的家伙，竟是夺取他原本应得的，这如何能不让他愤怒？如何不能他心生妒火？
换做普通人都受不了，何况他还是秦家四府年轻一辈中的第一人，天之骄子！

秦开秦和二人见眼前这位突然不说话，瞬间急了，对于实力比他们弱的秦轩能获得‘重宝’，他们当然也心有不满，以他们的实力，对付一名炼体六重的武者来说，简直可以说是完杀，也就西府秦江伟那废物才会被其斩杀。
当听闻秦轩获得老祖宗的‘重宝’后，除了东府外，其余两府的人已经开始有动作了，北府自然不能落下，不过，以他们二人的实力，虽说不弱，但是四府中比他们强的依旧不少，在那么多人的情况下他们根本讨不到好处。
也正因为这样，所以他们找上了秦易，凭借四府年轻一辈第一人，绝对可以震慑大部分人。
到最后，就算‘重宝’归秦易所得，至少他们也能分点羹。
人不为己，天诛地灭！
“大哥，其余两府的人都已经准备出手了，若是我们还没动静，怕到时候就晚了！”一旁的秦开急道。
瞥了秦开秦和兄弟一眼，心中冷笑，凭借秦易的才智如何不知道这两个家伙心中的小心思，虽说这两个家伙叫秦易大哥，可秦易可根本没将他们当兄弟，若不是他们实力不错，还有点利用价值，秦易才不会去搭理他们。
点了点头，秦易依旧笑容满面，只是在这抹笑容下却多出了一丝寒意，“说吧，把知道的都说出来。”
两人对视了一眼，心中一喜，他们知道，沉寂许久的秦易，终于要动手！
“昨日，有人见秦轩从龙阁出来，并且前往火焰山脉，已经有部分两府的人前往跟踪，我北府也已经派遣强者尾随。”秦开恭敬的说道，声音压抑不住兴奋，“这是我们最好的机会，大哥，动手吧！”
秦和也是一脸期待，他相信，只要秦易动手，这事绝对没有意外！
“火焰山脉吗？”沉思低吟片刻，秦易微微一笑，起身往外走去，“走吧，也是时候让这些不知天高地厚的家伙知道，谁才是秦家四府年轻一辈第一人了。”
火焰山脉位于洛河城北面，火焰山脉并非真的整个山脉都是火焰，而是因为其常年被一层火红色的雾气笼罩，远远看去，就如天边的火焰一般，所以才被称为火焰山脉。
此时，在火焰山脉的外围，一名身穿黑色劲服的少年静静匍匐着，整个人掩盖在灌木丛中，双眼紧紧盯着前方一头正在啃食的‘黑齿豹’，全身的肌肉紧绷。
体内的玄气微微一动，脚下猛的发力，黑衣少年整个人顿时如炮弹一般弹射出去，手中不知何时已经多了一把巨刃。
剑光一闪而过，速度快到了极致，那黑齿豹甚至来不及反应，整个身体已经被切成两半，猩红的鲜血洒落一地，将脚下的土壤浸红。
“呼。”
轻吐一口浊气，秦轩将手中的巨剑收了起来，随后熟练的从黑齿豹脑袋上掏出一颗闪烁着黑芒的魔核，将魔核表面的血渍擦干，这才心满意足的将其收入空间戒子中。
距离来到火焰山脉已经过去整整一天了，虽然只有短短的一天，但是秦轩所遇到的魔兽却不下百头，遇到强大的，他就跑，遇到实力差不多的，他就拿来当做磨练剑法。
像这黑齿豹，是最为普通常见的魔兽之一，虽说只有两级，但若不是秦轩偷袭在先，怕是也不可能这么轻易将其斩杀。

“这还只是外围，真不知道这火焰山脉的内围到底会多恐怖。”暗自感叹一声，秦轩继续往前走去。
在龙阁呆了近十天，秦轩愕然的发现，自己的修为到炼体六重巅峰后，竟是怎么也无法突破至第七重，而且那经脉修复的速度也停止了。
而恰巧在这时候，老祖却将他从龙阁踢了出来，美其名曰，磨练磨练！
本想从老祖口中套出一点信息的秦轩，顿时没了办法，不过唯一值得庆幸的是，虽说如今修为还是炼体六重，但是经过这一天与魔兽的各种搏杀，秦轩对于盖伦的力量更加的得心应手。
至少现在，秦轩在不使用盖伦力量的前提下，也能自信的在九重强者攻击下处于不败的局面。
“难道是因为上次‘英雄神典’的事情？”眉头微微一皱，秦轩很快便召唤出盖伦，然而得到的却是否定的回答。
“主人，‘英雄神典’虽然还在不满，但是他还不屑这么做，况且如此一来，对他也没有任何好处。”
点了点头，经过盖伦这么一说，秦轩也明白过来，‘英雄神典’虽说牛气，但是说到底，还是得靠自己这个主人，若是阻碍自己成长，那么想必‘英雄神典’也不会太好过。
特别是以秦轩这些天的观察，‘英雄神典’的灵魂绝不是一个甘愿平庸，碌碌无为的家伙！
“那么到底是怎么回事呢？”
秦轩有些纳闷，不能突破至第七重，也就代表着他不能召唤第二位英雄，期待了那么久，可却换来这样的结果，如何让人接受得了？
沉默了许久，盖伦突然说道，“主人，我猜‘英雄神典’当初要那件重宝肯定不无道理，说不定这两者存在着一定的关联。”
闻言，秦轩心中不由得一动，盖伦这么一说，倒也提醒了他，可若是这时候将重宝‘离火钟’交出去，岂不是说自己率先低头了？
可要是不拼一下，自己能不能突破至炼体第七重还是个未知数。
拼，跟‘英雄神典’低头，且失去重宝‘离火钟’，有一定的几率突破目前的修为屏障，晋级炼体七重。
不拼，可能永远停滞在体悟六重的境界，并且损失的七层经脉也将无法修复。
就在秦轩左右为难时，盖伦的神色猛的一肃，两条剑眉紧紧锁着，手中的正义之剑嗡嗡作响。
“主人，我们被包围了！”

Chapter 13 Galen’s speculation (second update please vote)
In the Qin family's northern mansion, rows of family guards wearing thick silver armor were patrolling. As they walked, the armors constantly collided with each other, making harsh metal sounds. Their sharp eyes swept around, and the guards were extremely tight.
East courtyard of Beifu.
There was an explosion, and the wooden table in front of him suddenly exploded. Wood chips flew and scattered all over the floor. The powerful blow directly left a deep palm print on the stone floor.
"Are you telling the truth?" Behind the palm print, a young man in rich clothes stood with a faint smile on his face, his eyes slightly narrowed, looking like a good old man.
But if you look carefully, you will find that there is a cold light in his light blue eyes, "Ancestor really handed that heavy treasure to Qin Xuan?"
In front of the young man, there was a man of similar age standing on each side. When he saw the power of the young man in the Chinese uniform, his face was shocked. Especially when he felt the undisguised coldness coming from the young man, he was secretly afraid in his heart.
The young man in Huafu is named Qin Yi. He is only twenty-four years old. He is the eldest among the four houses of the Qin family and the son of the master of the Beifu. Not only that, his strength is also the first among the younger generation of the four houses of the Qin family!
However, this is not the reason why he is feared. Although this man always looks harmless to humans and animals, his mind is extremely cunning, just like a poisonous snake hiding in the dark. As long as he finds an opportunity, he will choose people to bite and kill them with one strike!
"Brother, this news has already spread among the four houses of the Qin family. How could we two brothers lie to you?" said the slightly older man on the left. This man's name is Qin Kai, and the other man is Qin He.
Both of them have reached the ninth level of body refining!
Nodding, Qin He also echoed from the side, "That's right, brother, how can Qin Xuanhe De possess such a heavy treasure? In terms of strength, he is only at the sixth level of body refining, not even as good as my two brothers, let alone you, big brother."
"In terms of talent, he is less than one-tenth of yours. My ancestor actually handed over this important treasure to him. I don't know if my ancestor was bewitched by that kid!"
After saying that, Qin He looked resentful and resentful, as if he felt unworthy of Qin Yi.
"Haha..."
With a soft smile, Qin Yi did not speak immediately, leaving people wondering what he was thinking, and the jealousy in his heart quietly ignited.
During the original clan meeting, he was also excited and passionate about the words "heavy treasure". In his opinion, with his strength, this "heavy treasure" simply belongs to him!
So during the clan meeting, he just watched with cold eyes and was not eager to take action. Whether it was Qin Jiangwei who was arrogant and domineering at the clan meeting or Qin Xuan who suddenly became a blockbuster, they were just a bunch of clowns.
However, this guy who existed like an ant in his eyes actually took away what he originally deserved. How could this not make him angry? How could he not be jealous?
An ordinary person wouldn't be able to bear it, not to mention that he is the first among the younger generation of the Qin family, the proud son of heaven!
Qin Kai, Qin and the other two became anxious when they saw the man in front of them suddenly stopped talking. Of course, they were dissatisfied with the fact that Qin Xuan, who was weaker than them, could obtain the 'heavy treasure'. With their strength, it could be said that they would kill a warrior at the sixth level of body refining, and only the useless Qin Jiangwei of Xifu would be killed by him.
After hearing that Qin Xuan had obtained the 'heavy treasure' from his ancestors, except for the East Palace, the people in the other two palaces had already begun to take action. Naturally, the North Palace could not be left behind. However, with the strength of the two of them, although they were not weak, there were still many stronger than them among the four palaces. With so many people, they could not get any benefit at all.
It is precisely because of this that they approached Qin Yi, who could definitely intimidate most people by virtue of being the number one young man in the four houses.
In the end, even if the 'heavy treasure' goes to Qin Yi, at least they can get a piece of the pie.
Not for oneself, damned to heaven and earth!
"Brother, the people from the other two houses are already preparing to take action. If we haven't made any move yet, I'm afraid it will be too late by then!" Qin Kai said anxiously.
Glancing at Qin Kai, Qin He and his brothers, he sneered in his heart. With Qin Yi's intelligence, he didn't know the inner thoughts of these two guys. Although these two guys were called Qin Yi's eldest brother, Qin Yi didn't regard them as brothers at all. If they weren't quite capable and somewhat valuable, Qin Yi wouldn't bother with them.
Nodding, Qin Yi was still smiling, but there was a hint of chill under this smile, "Go on, tell me everything you know."
The two of them looked at each other and felt happy. They knew that Qin Yi, who had been silent for a long time, was finally going to take action!
"Yesterday, someone saw Qin Xuan coming out of the Dragon Pavilion and heading to the Flame Mountains. Some people from the two palaces have already gone to follow him. Our North Palace has also sent strong men to follow." Qin Kai said respectfully, his voice unable to suppress his excitement, "This is our best opportunity, brother, let's do it!"
Qin He also looked forward to it. He believed that as long as Qin Yi took action, there would be no accidents!
"Fire Mountains?" Qin Yi murmured for a moment, smiled slightly, stood up and walked out, "Let's go, it's time to let these guys who don't know the heights of the world know who is the number one among the younger generation in the four houses of the Qin family."
The Flame Mountains are located to the north of Luohe City. The Flame Mountains are not really filled with flames, but because they are shrouded in a layer of fiery red mist all year round. From a distance, they look like flames on the horizon, so they are called the Flame Mountains.
At this time, on the outskirts of the Flame Mountains, a young man wearing black clothes was crawling quietly, his whole body hidden in the bushes, his eyes fixed on a 'black-toothed leopard' that was gnawing in front of him, and the muscles in his whole body were tense.
The profound energy in his body moved slightly, and he exerted force under his feet. The boy in black was ejected like a cannonball, and he didn't know when he had a giant blade in his hand.
The sword light flashed past, so fast that the black-toothed leopard didn't even have time to react. His entire body had been cut in half, and scarlet blood spilled all over the ground, soaking the soil under his feet red.
"Huh."
With a breath of turbid breath, Qin Xuan put away the giant sword in his hand, then skillfully took out a shining black magic core from the head of the black-toothed leopard, wiped the blood on the surface of the magic core, and then put it into the space ring with satisfaction.
It has been a full day since he arrived at the Flame Mountains. Although it was only a short day, Qin Xuan encountered no less than a hundred monsters. When he encountered powerful ones, he ran away. When he encountered those of similar strength, he used them to practice his sword skills.
The black-toothed leopard is one of the most common monsters. Although it only has two levels, if Qin Xuan hadn't made a sneak attack first, he probably wouldn't have been able to kill it so easily.
"This is just the outer perimeter. I really don't know how terrifying the inner perimeter of the Flame Mountain Range will be." Qin Xuan sighed secretly and continued to walk forward.
After staying in the Dragon Pavilion for nearly ten days, Qin Xuan was shocked to find that after his cultivation reached the peak of the sixth level of body refining, he could not break through to the seventh level, and the speed of repairing his meridians also stopped.
But it happened that at this time, the ancestor kicked him out of the Dragon Pavilion, euphemistically calling it training and training!
Qin Xuan, who wanted to extract some information from his ancestor, suddenly had no choice but to be thankful. Although his cultivation level was still at the sixth level of body refining, after this day's various battles with monsters, Qin Xuan became more comfortable with Galen's power.
At least now, without using Galen's power, Qin Xuan can confidently remain invincible under the attack of the ninth level powerhouse.
"Is it because of what happened with the 'Heroes Divine Code' last time?" Qin Xuan frowned slightly and quickly summoned Galen, but the answer he received was a negative one.
"Master, 'English'Although "Xiong Shen Dian" is still dissatisfied, he still doesn't bother to do this, and besides, it won't do him any good. "
Nodding, after what Galen said, Qin Xuan also understood that although the 'Divine Heroes' is impressive, in the final analysis, he still has to rely on himself as the master. If it hinders his own growth, then the 'Divine Heroes' will not be too happy.
Especially based on Qin Xuan's observations these days, the soul of the 'Hero Divine Code' is definitely not a guy who is willing to be mediocre and mediocre!
"So what happened? "
Qin Xuan was a little confused. If he couldn't break through to the seventh level, it meant that he couldn't summon the second hero. He had been waiting for so long, but he got such a result. How could anyone accept it?
After being silent for a long time, Galen suddenly said, "Master, I guess it was reasonable for the 'Divine Heroes' to want that important treasure in the first place. Maybe there is a certain connection between the two. "
Hearing this, Qin Xuan couldn't help but feel something in his heart. Galen's words reminded him, but if he handed over the important treasure "Lihuo Bell" at this time, wouldn't it mean that he had bowed his head first?
But if he doesn't work hard, it's still unknown whether he can break through to the seventh level of body refining.
If you fight hard, bow your head to the 'Divine Code of Heroes', and lose the important treasure 'Lihuo Bell', there is a certain chance of breaking through the current cultivation barrier and advancing to the seventh level of body refining.
If you don't work hard, you may always be stuck in the realm of the sixth level of understanding, and the lost seven levels of meridians will not be repaired.
Just when Qin Xuan was in a dilemma, Galen's expression suddenly became solemn, his eyebrows were tightly locked, and the sword of justice in his hand buzzed.
"Master, we are surrounded! "
